Beyond creating a more audit-proof sales process, digitised enquiries provide a rich dataset for meaningful sales analysis. Visualising incoming enquiries across products, customers, and regions enables sales managers to identify patterns, shifts in demand, and early signals of market changes.

Analysing enquiry-to-offer-to-deal ratios provides valuable insight into sales execution. It highlights how often enquiries are not pursued, where offers fail to convert, and which customers or products consistently underperform.

This analysis helps identify which customers, regions, or sales channels consistently deliver higher netbacks and which transactions underperform once costs are taken into account. In heavy industries like metals and mining, direct procurement dominates the cost base, carrying the primary profit and margin risks because raw materials and energy heavily shape EBITDA.

While direct procurement influences margin via raw material costs, indirect procurement supports overall profitability by maximising operational efficiency, preventing plant downtime, and maintaining corporate compliance.
